verdict.rationale: Brex's AI page describes assistants that write memos, fetch receipts and file reimbursements, plus agents that categorize spend and an audit agent that flags policy violations by risk level (brex-docs-23, brex-docs-41, brex-docs-15, brex-docs-16). Receipt upload with automatic matching to expenses is documented in the API (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-27). Missing for 10: explicit duplicate or fraud detection (the audit agent only covers policy violations), detail on extracting receipt contents for expenses, and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
